[[3 ABY]]The flashbacks of [[Star Wars (2020) 50|''Star Wars'' (2020) 50]] take place approximately twenty-two [[Standard year|years]] after [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine's]] [[Proclamation of the New Order|ascension]] to [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]], meaning they must occur around [[3 ABY]]. The flashbacks also take place after the events of [[Star Wars (2020) 43|''Star Wars'' (2020) 43]], which occur after the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Droids]]'' crossover event, an event {{SW|url=news/marvel-dark-droids-interview|text=Charles Soule Unleashes ''Dark Droids''}} places after ''[[Star Wars: War of the Bounty Hunters]]'', which is dated to 3 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]] by ''Timelines''. As ''Darth Vader'' (2020) 32 takes place between ''War of the Bounty Hunters'' and ''Dark Droids'', its events must take place around 3 ABY. |series=[[Star Wars: Darth Vader (2020)|''Star Wars: Darth Vader'' (2020)]] |issue=32 }} '''''Darth Vader'' 32''' is the thirty-second issue of the [[2020]] [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series [[Star Wars: Darth Vader (2020)|''Star Wars: Darth Vader'']]. The issue was written by [[Greg Pak]], illustrated by [[Ibraim Roberson]] and [[Federico Blee]], and published by [[Marvel Comics]] on [[March 22]], [[2023]]. ==Publisher's summary== ''HANDMAIDEN NO MORE? Few bonds in the galaxy are as strong as the sisterhood of the former handmaidens of Padmé Amidala. But all that was threatened when Sabé entered the service of Darth Vader, the man the handmaidens always believed was responsible for Padmé's death. Now Dormé, Saché, Rabé and Eirtaé are determined to save Sabé – or stop her, no matter what. But the influence of the Dark Lord is strong and dangerous – and not just to Sabé. What path will the handmaidens choose? And how does all this play into Darth Vader's true plans?'' ==Opening crawl== {{OpeningCrawl |name=HANDMAIDEN
NO MORE? |text=Following Jul Tambor's kidnapping of Sabé, the remaining former handmaidens of Padmé Amidala formed an uneasy alliance with Darth Vader to stage a daring rescue. Throughout the battle against Jul's droid army, the handmaidens realized that they were simply being used as Vader's pawns so he could rescue Sabé and fully immerse her into his dark machinations. Now Sabé must decide if she is to remain loyal to the sisterhood of the handmaidens or join Vader in his violent crusade against Jul Tambor….}} ==Plot summary== {{Plot|comic}} ==Media==
